_readme: Official Yamaha photos for the catalogue, stock thumbnails and customer showcase. Put licensed image files in this folder (or use full https:// URLs) and list them here by model id, then by colour name exactly as it appears in the app. Use "*" for photos that suit every colour. Photos an Admin uploads in the Catalogue Manager take priority over these. Example: "mt15-v2": { "Racing Blue": ["/images/catalogue/mt15-v2-racing-blue.webp"], "*": ["/images/catalogue/mt15-v2-studio.webp"] }. Model ids: mt15-v2, r15, aerox-155, fzs-fi-v4, fz-x, rayzr-125, fascino-125.
